shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A woman in a teal sweater sits at the shelf-side window seat and explains the starting rules, while a woman in a mustard cardigan sits at the shelf-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.

shots.content: A man in a maroon hoodie enters and sits at the doorway-side window seat. A woman in a teal sweater asks a question.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a teal sweater replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the shelving-unit end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the doorway, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.
